snippet.title: A Spaceship Accident - Trailer
snippet.description:
"A Spaceship Accident" is a choice-driven narrative game with RPG mechanics, filled with cosmic wonders and horror. Forge your own path across more than 50 unique endings. Barter, upgrade your character, fight, and explore alien worlds, overcoming every obstacle to find your way back to Earth… and to your daughter.
The release date is November 27, 2025.
Wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886120/A_Spaceship_Accident/
